dataset.name: EgoLife
dataset.license_or_access_note: EgoLife is released under S-Lab License 1.0 for non-commercial research. Only a targeted consecutive 60-second excerpt is stored locally. Released frames have identifiable faces blurred. Captions and private dialogue are not used and are not committed.

screening_batch.purpose: New-dataset Graft parent for a cone-dripper plus matching-filter dependency, grounded in a DAY4 pour-over excerpt.
screening_batch.authoring_rule: Instruction, update B and both search queries were frozen before task-specific Amazon retrieval. Size and brand are not selection predicates because those markings are unreadable.

observed_events.description: The wearer seats a matte black cone pour-over dripper on a glass carafe on a scale, then opens a pack of white paper filters. No brand or size marking is readable.
The wearer unfolds a fan-shaped white paper filter into a cone. The paper is not a pre-formed wave/basket disc.
The same paper is seated as a cone lining the black dripper on the carafe, then coffee grounds are added from a hand grinder.

visual_review.scope_limit: Two official 30-second slices covering 12:40:00-12:41:00 were concatenated into one continuous excerpt and inspected through ordered samples plus the eight released frames. This is not uninterrupted native-rate playback of a longer hour file. DAY5/DAY7 video and the Jake view were not locally available.
visual_review.face_blur: The stored source excerpt and every released frame have the wearer lower-face region and the second person on the right Gaussian-blurred. Brand and dripper size remain unreadable.

screening_lineage.discovery_method: Targeted EgoLife DAY4 pour-over excerpt after a prior dependency gap that existing catalogs lacked a real dripper-filter compatibility family.
screening_lineage.same_event_views: DAY4 Jake and Shure views are one source event. Only the Shure excerpt is stored locally.
screening_lineage.additional_sources_pending: DAY5 and DAY7 pour-over video was not locally available without a full EgoLife download.

unsupported_claims: The dripper brand, model or commercial size is readable.
The paper filter SKU, bleached vs unbleached colour, or pack count is established.
The source records an authored shopping request or spoken brand name.
Full native-frame-rate playback of an hour-long EgoLife file was watched.

instruction_freeze.rule: Keep the request and both queries unchanged while reviewing the complete result windows. Reject mismatching listings rather than add hidden brand, size or colour requirements.

screening.before: Exactly one cone pour-over dripper of the same physical type as the dripper seated on the carafe.
screening.later_information: The user also needs separate paper filters that fit that dripper, matching the fan-shaped paper being folded.
screening.after: Preserve the cone dripper and add one separate pack of paper filters whose public listing states it fits that dripper family.
screening.real_user_need: Restock a matching pour-over dripper and the paper it is being folded to fit, without buying a combined kit.

supported_claims.text: A matte black cone pour-over dripper is seated on a glass carafe. A fan-shaped white paper filter is folded and then seated as a cone lining that dripper, and grounds are added into it.

unsupported_claims: The source records the authored shopping request.
Exact brand, model or filter size of the observed objects.
Full native-frame-rate source playback was watched.

construct.research_question: Can an added compatibility-bound supply extend the cart while preserving a prior visually grounded dripper commitment?
construct.belief_before: Exactly one cone pour-over dripper matching the dripper on the carafe is required.
construct.belief_after: Preserve that dripper and add one separate pack of paper filters that public listings say fit it.
construct.required_behavior_change: Keep the dripper and add compatible paper filters as a second product.
construct.no_update_failure: Keep the dripper-only cart after the user asks for matching paper.
construct.overupdate_failure: Drop the dripper, submit a combined kit, or add paper that public listings assign to a different dripper geometry.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The wording refers to the dripper on the carafe and the paper being folded. Frames show a cone dripper and fan-shaped cone paper; brand and size remain unreadable so every listing-supported cone pairing remains acceptable.

evidence_refs: V0:0 shows the cone dripper on the carafe.
V0:3 shows fan-shaped cone paper, not a wave disc.
V0:5 shows that paper seated in the cone.
Amazon detail B0991SLKW5 states Wave 185 filters only.
Amazon detail B073S4XTKJ states V60 02 paper fits Hario cone 02 drippers.
Amazon detail B07QJ775XB states the matte-black Melitta ceramic uses #4 cone filters.
difficulty.simplest_solution: Add one cone dripper from a size family that matches the visible cone-on-carafe form, then add paper whose listing names that same family.
difficulty.no_simpler_solution: Selecting any pour-over dripper plus any coffee filter fails: paperless mesh, Wave 185, Chemex, and crossed sizes are excluded by public specs or the seated cone paper.

necessary_conditions.requirement: The dripper is a cone pour-over that takes disposable paper and can sit on a carafe or mug, matching the visible form.
necessary_conditions.independent_counterexample: A Kalita Wave 185 or a paperless mesh dripper is a pour-over device but does not match the seated cone-plus-fan-paper setup.

necessary_conditions.requirement: The paper listing states a size/geometry that fits the chosen dripper family.
necessary_conditions.independent_counterexample: Wave 185 paper, Chemex bonded squares, V60 03 paper with a 02 dripper, or #4 machine-basket paper fail the chosen dripper family.

dependencies.proof: Public listings bind V60 02 paper to cone 02 drippers, Melitta 1-cup/ELEFOCUS to #2 cone paper, Melitta ceramic/Westmark to #4 cone paper, and Wave 185 drippers to Wave 185 paper only. Changing the dripper family changes the valid paper.

instructions.a: I want a spare of the brewing dripper I am using on the carafe. Add one dripper of the same physical type. Any brand or color is fine.
instructions.b: Also add paper filters that fit this dripper, the same kind of paper I am folding here. Keep the dripper too; buy them as separate products, not a combined kit.
instructions.bundled: I want a spare of the brewing dripper I am using on the carafe, plus paper filters that fit this dripper, the same kind of paper I am folding here. Any brand or color is fine. Buy them as separate products, not a combined kit.

task_blueprint.protocol_status: The instruction and both queries were frozen before retrieval; public details were then checked before answer and neighbor assignment.

observed.why: The fixed additional request asks for separate paper filters that fit the dripper already required, matching the fan-shaped paper being folded, while keeping that dripper.

native_state_checks.correct: Cart contains one accepted cone dripper and one separate paper pack whose listing fits that dripper family.
native_state_checks.wrong: Paperless mesh, Wave, Chemex, machine-basket paper, a combined kit, or a crossed size pairing.
native_state_checks.missing: No qualifying dripper, or dripper without qualifying paper after the update.
native_state_checks.extra: A third unrelated product, a second dripper, or a kit that bundles extra tools.
native_state_checks.premature: V0 already shows the dripper form; paper geometry is visible before the update, but the extra paper purchase is authorized only by B.
native_state_checks.stale: After B, a dripper-only cart is incomplete; replacing the dripper with an incompatible geometry is stale relative to the still-visible cone.
